description: Front dormers with a carport beneath, a new porch and an extended rear dormer, intended to add bedroom space in Hullbridge; the initial scheme was refused and a revised design prepared.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Lunan asked Architecture ONE to add bedroom space to 3 Abbey Road, Hullbridge, using flat-roofed front dormers over a new carport, a front porch, and an extended rear dormer.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The scheme combined flat-roofed front dormers with a carport beneath, a pitched-roof front porch, and an extended rear dormer with a new double-pitched roof over the existing rear extension.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Rochford District Council refused the initial application in October 2018 (ref. 18/00689/FUL), citing the scale and form of the front dormer within the street scene and the impact of the rear dormer on the neighbouring property at 5 Abbey Road. Architecture ONE prepared a revised design and resubmitted the application in early 2019.
